title: Turkey Tail Mushroom Side Effects and Precautions
abstract: Throughout its long history of use in Eastern medicine and more recent use as a health supplement in western cultures, the turkey tail mushroom has shown no significant negative side effects for most people.\*. ### Side Effects of Turkey Tail Mushrooms. Most people who eat turkey tail mushrooms or take them in supplement form tolerate them well and have no side effects, even when taking them at high doses. Some supplements contain whole mushroom in powdered form, such as Gaia Herbs Turkey Tail Mushroom, and others contain one or both of the compounds extracted from the mushroom: PSK and PSP. ### Turkey Tail Mushroom Combined with Other Mushroom Supplements. Gaia Herbs offers an Immune Mushroom Blend, which includes turkey tail, reishi, cordyceps, shitake, and chaga to support your body’s immune defenses and maintain well-being.\*. So, if you’re looking for a safe, widely-researched, and antioxidant-rich mushroom supplement to support immune health, gut health, and liver health, turkey tail mushroom is a good one to add to your natural health maintenance regimen.\*.
